recreation_brief:
1. SLIDE SETUP: Set the slide background to light grey #F5F5F5, full bleed. (No content-area border is attested in the source; do not add one.)
2. FOOTER: Draw a black (#000000) rectangle spanning 100% width along the very bottom edge (approx. bottom 3% of slide height).
3. TITLE: Add the text 'Gradient Descent' at top-left (approx. x=2%, y=2%), bold sans-serif, color #D00000 (red), largest font size on the slide.
4. UPDATE-EQUATION BOX: Directly below the title (approx. 0-35% width, 8-30% height), draw a white (#FFFFFF) rectangle with a red (#FF0000) border. Inside, left-aligned, three black equation lines rendered exactly as: (a) $W_{ji}^{Updated} = W_{ji}^{old} - \eta \frac{\partial E}{\partial W_{ji}}$ ; (b) $W_{ji}^{Updated} = W_{ji}^{old} + \Delta_{ji}$ ; (c) Where $\Delta_{ji} = -\eta \frac{\partial E}{\partial W_{ji}}$. Color the eta and Delta symbols red (#FF0000).
5. NEURAL NETWORK DIAGRAM (top-right quadrant, approx. 35-90% width, 0-30% height): left to right draw (i) a column of purple (#800080) input dots, (ii) middle columns of grey (#808080) circles each containing a Sigma symbol plus blue (#0000FF) processing nodes, (iii) exactly three green/yellow (#00FF00/#FFFF00) output nodes on the right. Connect adjacent layers with thin weighted-connection lines. Add curved arrows from the output side back toward the network for error flow. Add green (#00FF00) upward arrows labeled '1' beside nodes. Place labels: 'Net1', 'Net2', 'Net m' above the output nodes; 'O1', 'O2', 'Om' at the output nodes; 'Output 1', 'Output 2', 'Output m' to the right of the output nodes. At the diagram's bottom-left add small black text 'Node Bias' with a small bias icon.
6. ERROR PANEL (far top-right, approx. 90-100% width, 0-30% height): draw a vertical red (#FF0000) bar labeled 'Error'; to its right stack three labels top-to-bottom: 'Error Class 1', 'Error Class 2', 'Error Class m' (green per source brief).
7. SLIDE NUMBER: at the top-right corner place a yellow (#FFFF00) circle containing the black numeral '9'.
8. MIDDLE EQUATION STRIP (full width, approx. 30-45% height), three items left-to-right in black: (a) $E = \frac{1}{2} \sum_j (t_j - O_j)^2$ ; (b) the words 'For Sigmoid Activation' in blue (#0000FF) followed by $O_j = f(Net_j) = \frac{1}{1+e^{-Net_j}}$ ; (c) $Net_j = \sum_i (w_{ji} O_i)$.
9. DERIVATIVE BOXES ROW (full width, approx. 45-55% height): draw exactly three equal white (#FFFFFF) rectangles with blue (#0000FF) borders side by side containing, left to right: (a) $\frac{\partial E}{\partial O_j} = -(t_j - O_j)$ ; (b) $\frac{\partial O_j}{\partial Net_j} = O_j(1-O_j)$ ; (c) $\frac{\partial Net_j}{\partial W_{ji}} = O_i$.
10. CHAIN-RULE BOX (bottom-left, approx. 0-70% width, 55-85% height): draw a large white (#FFFFFF) rectangle with a red (#FF0000) border containing two black equation lines: (a) $\frac{\partial E}{\partial W_{ji}} = \frac{\partial E}{\partial O_j} * \frac{\partial O_j}{\partial Net_j} * \frac{\partial Net_j}{\partial W_{ji}}$ ; (b) $= -(t_j - O_j) * O_j(1-O_j) * O_i$. Inside the box near its right edge place a small grey (#808080) pen/stylus icon.
11. SUMMARY BOX (bottom-right, approx. 70-95% width, 55-85% height): draw a light-yellow (#FFFFE0) rectangle with a blue (#0000FF) border repeating the three derivatives: $\frac{\partial E}{\partial O_j} = -(t_j - O_j)$ ; $\frac{\partial O_j}{\partial Net_j} = O_j(1-O_j)$ ; $\frac{\partial Net_j}{\partial W_{ji}} = O_i$.
